question: Which team had the highest map win rate in 2024, among teams with at least 30 maps?
sql: WITH team_map_counts AS (SELECT team_id, COUNT(DISTINCT match_map_id) AS maps_played FROM (SELECT team_a_id AS team_id, match_map_id FROM fact_map_result WHERE year = 2024 UNION ALL SELECT team_b_id AS team_id, match_map_id FROM fact_map_result WHERE year = 2024) GROUP BY team_id), team_map_wins AS (SELECT winner_team_id AS team_id, COUNT(DISTINCT match_map_id) AS maps_won FROM fact_map_result WHERE year = 2024 AND NOT winner_team_id IS NULL GROUP BY winner_team_id) SELECT t.team_name, c.maps_played, COALESCE(w.maps_won, 0) AS maps_won, ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(w.maps_won, 0) / c.maps_played, 1) AS map_win_rate FROM team_map_counts AS c JOIN dim_team AS t ON c.team_id = t.team_id LEFT JOIN team_map_wins AS w ON c.team_id = w.team_id WHERE c.maps_played >= 30 ORDER BY map_win_rate DESC LIMIT 1
explanation: Based on the measure of map win rate, Gen.G had the highest map win rate in 2024 with 65.2% across 112 maps played and 73 maps won.
